utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can be there this afternoon, around 3 if that works.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: 3 works for me. Are you meeting at the community hall first?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: The east fence would help most. I’ll send you over there, and we can look at the loose boards after.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, I’ll head over to the east fence and bring my tools with me.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep you posted as soon as I have any updates, and I can take one of the first houses or handle contact follow-up. I’m also heading over early to help with setup.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, Vik. Please take a first house if you can, and send me any timing changes right away so I don’t double-book anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, the repair drive. What still needs doing, and where can I help? I’ve got a few tools and can come by today.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Oren. We’re set for Sunday at the community center now, and I can use your help on the first two house pickups if you’re free today.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It’s today at the community center, and I’m setting up the repair station there. If you can bring the tools and help sort the supplies when you arrive, that would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Got it, I’ll bring the tools and help sort the supplies when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, the repair drive. What still needs doing, and where can I help? I’ve got a few tools and can come by today.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: They’re still sorting tools and supplies at the community hall, and a few folks are lining up to help this afternoon. I’m still waiting on the final schedule, but I can pass along your tools and help offer to the others.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I’m still pulling the list together, so if you’ve got tools or can take one house, send me your availability and I’ll slot you in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help set up a bit early, and I’m free to take one house too. Send me the time and place, and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It’s today at the community center, and I’m getting the repair station set up there. Could you bring the tools and help sort the supplies when you arrive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I’ll bring the tools and help sort supplies at the community center. Send me any last-minute changes and I’ll keep everyone updated.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time are you heading over for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still pinning that down, since I need to line up the first houses and make sure the list is set. I’ll send the time as soon as I have the route sorted.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still a bit behind on the details, but I heard it’s today at the community center. What have you heard about what they need most?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m a little behind too, so just tell me the first repair they need and I’ll handle it.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
